Trinity S³AI

Capstone: a filter as the board computes it

Design a low-pass, feed it two tones as 16-bit samples and see what the RTL arithmetic outputs next to the same filter in f64, down to the last bit.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • R. G. Lyons, Understanding Digital Signal Processing, 3rd ed., ch. 12: digital data formats and their effects
  • Xilinx UG479, 7 Series DSP48E1 Slice User Guide: the 48-bit accumulator the sum fits in
